scenarios.name: partial_write_trailing_truncation
scenarios.injected_fault: Process crash leaving 48 trailing zeroed bytes in final frame
scenarios.expected_outcome: Detect incomplete frame, log warning, truncate to last valid record
scenarios.measured_outcome: Truncated to record 9,999; 0 unhandled exceptions; 100% CRC32 valid

scenarios.name: corrupted_payload_crc32
scenarios.injected_fault: Flipped single bit in frame payload byte offset 2500
scenarios.expected_outcome: ChecksumError raised with sequence and byte offset; segment isolated
scenarios.measured_outcome: Explicit ChecksumError caught; zero silent acceptance of corrupt record

scenarios.name: slow_consumer_socket_backpressure
scenarios.injected_fault: Consumer paused socket reads for 5.0 seconds under 15k eps ingest
scenarios.expected_outcome: Drop counter increments, client evicted after >= 10 drops, 0 engine stall
scenarios.measured_outcome: Client evicted exactly at drop #10; other clients 100% delivered; 0 engine jitter

scenarios.name: partition_ownership_fencing_collision
scenarios.injected_fault: Concurrent secondary process attempts to acquire held shard.lock
scenarios.expected_outcome: Secondary detects lock contention and immediately exits with code 42
scenarios.measured_outcome: Secondary exited with code 42 in 2.4 ms; primary completely undisturbed

scenarios.name: storage_drainer_disk_backpressure
scenarios.injected_fault: Simulated disk write stall (100 ms fsync delay)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Queue expands to ceiling, memory bounded, batches flush once disk clears
scenarios.measured_outcome: Memory stayed bounded (+4.1 MB); batches flushed cleanly with 0 dropped events
